faq.heading: Common questions.
faq.contactPre: Can't find what you're looking for?

items.a: Yes, completely. Buyers never pay anything. We earn from dealership subscriptions, not from you.

items.q: How do I know dealers are trustworthy?
items.a: Every dealer is manually verified. We check business registration and dealer licences before approving any dealership, and you can see each dealer's profile before you respond.

items.q: What happens if I don't like any offers?
items.a: Nothing. You have zero obligation to accept any offer. Your request simply expires after 30 days, and you can create a new one anytime.

items.q: Can dealers contact me by phone?
items.a: No. All communication stays inside AutoVerkauf until you choose to share your contact details with a specific dealer.

items.q: How many offers will I get?
items.a: It depends on how specific your request is and how many dealers carry a match. Offers land in your dashboard as dealers respond — and you're never obligated to accept any of them.

items.q: What information do dealers see about me?
items.a: Only your vehicle requirements and your canton. Your name, email and phone number are never shared until you choose to contact a specific dealer.

items.q: Can I submit a request for more than one car?
items.a: Yes. You can have up to three active requests at the same time.

items.q: How do I become a verified dealer?
items.a: Apply as a dealer and complete the verification form. We review every application before approving it.

about.title: Buying a car in Switzerland should work the other way around.
about.p1: The traditional way to buy a car means spending hours on listing sites, driving across cantons for test drives, and negotiating with dealers who hold all the information. AutoVerkauf flips that model.
about.p2: You describe what you want once — budget, body type, fuel, features, canton. Verified Swiss dealerships review your request and send you their best matching offer. <s>You choose who to contact, if anyone.</s> Your name, email, and phone number stay private until you decide to share them.
about.p3: We're a small team based in Switzerland. We built AutoVerkauf because we believe buyers deserve a process that works for them — not for the dealer with the biggest ad budget.
about.p4: AutoVerkauf is always free for buyers. We earn through dealership subscriptions. That alignment matters: our incentive is to bring you quality offers, not clicks.

privacy.b: When you create a request: your vehicle preferences, budget range, and canton. When you create an account: your email address and a hashed password. We never collect or store your phone number, physical address, or payment details.

Your vehicle preferences are shared with verified dealerships so they can send you relevant offers. Your contact details (name, email) are never shared with dealers unless you initiate contact with a specific dealer yourself.
Data is stored on Supabase infrastructure hosted in the EU. We retain your request data for 30 days after a request expires. Account data is retained until you delete your account.
We use a single session cookie for authentication and a locale cookie to remember your language preference. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.
Under Swiss nDSG and EU GDPR you have the right to access, correct, export, or delete your personal data. Email us at privacy@autoverkauf.ch to exercise these rights.

terms.b: AutoVerkauf is a marketplace that connects car buyers with verified Swiss dealerships. Buyers submit vehicle requests; dealers respond with offers. AutoVerkauf does not sell cars and is not party to any transaction between buyer and dealer.

The service is free for buyers. You may submit up to three active requests at a time. Requests expire after 30 days. You have no obligation to accept any offer. You must be at least 18 years old and a resident of Switzerland to use the service.

Dealers must be licensed Swiss motor vehicle dealers. Access requires a paid subscription and manual verification. Offers submitted must be genuine and accurate. Dealers may not contact buyers outside the platform before the buyer shares their contact details.
You may not use AutoVerkauf to submit false or misleading requests or offers, to spam other users, to reverse-engineer the platform, or for any unlawful purpose.
AutoVerkauf is provided as-is. We are not liable for the accuracy of dealer offers, the outcome of any transaction, or any indirect damages arising from use of the platform.
These terms are governed by Swiss law. The courts of Switzerland have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute.
